fullPassage:
Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell it and add the money to buy a new one."

He acted fast. He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone and posted the picture, with a short comment, on an online market: "Used bike in excellent condition. Only 100,000 won. Please text me." He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the shiny new bike. He could not wait to get a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post down the list. His heart began to sink.

"What's wrong with my posting? Is my bike not attractive enough?" He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike. He added more photos to show his bike from different angles. "Twenty-four inch bicycle. Excellent condition. Always kept indoors. Rides just like new. Very few scratches. Good for someone 12-14 years old. 80,000 won."

This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a lower price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed. Now he could get a new bike. He felt both happy and sad. He was sad to see his old bike go, but he was happy with himself because he had learned a lot and grown up a bit through the experience.

questions.passage: Seyun ①<u>rides</u> his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he ②<u>is</u> taller and stronger this year. His bike ③<u>has</u> become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he ④<u>do</u> not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 주어 he는 3인칭 단수이므로 부정문에서 does not을 써야 한다. do는 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ do 가 틀림 — 주어 he(3인칭 단수)의 부정문이므로 does not have로 써야 한다.
❌ ① rides : 주어 Seyun(단수)에 맞는 동사, 맞음.
❌ ② is : 'he is taller(그는 더 크다)'의 be동사, 맞음.
❌ ③ has : 'has become(~해졌다)'의 현재완료, 맞음.
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어의 부정문 → does not + 동사원형.

questions.passage: He acted fast. He ①<u>took</u> a photo of his bike with his smartphone and ②<u>post</u> the picture, with a short comment, on an online market. He was excited, ③<u>thinking</u> about the bike he planned to buy. He could ④<u>see</u> himself riding the shiny new bike. He could not wait to get a reply to his online advertisement.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 'took a photo ~ and posted the picture'처럼 took과 and로 연결되므로 과거형 posted를 써야 한다. post는 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ② post 가 틀림 — 앞의 took(과거형)과 and로 병렬 연결되므로 똑같이 과거형 posted로 써야 한다.
❌ ① took : 'take a photo(사진을 찍다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ③ thinking : 'He was excited, thinking(신이 나서 ~하면서)'의 분사구문, 맞음.
❌ ④ see : 조동사 could 뒤의 동사원형, 맞음.
det.tip: A and B 병렬 연결 → 시제·형태를 똑같이 맞춘다 (took and posted).

questions.passage: He could not wait ①<u>getting</u> a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits ②<u>went</u> up, his expectations went up too. Nobody ③<u>seemed</u> to want his bike. His heart ④<u>began</u> to sink.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 'can't[couldn't] wait to + 동사원형(몹시 ~하고 싶다)'이므로 to get으로 써야 한다. getting은 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ① getting 이 틀림 — 'could not wait to get(~을 몹시 받고 싶었다)'처럼 'wait to + 동사원형'으로 써야 한다.
❌ ② went : 'went up(올라갔다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ③ seemed : 'seemed to want(원하는 것 같았다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ④ began : 'began to sink(가라앉기 시작했다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
det.tip: can't wait to + 동사원형 = ~하기를 몹시 바라다.

questions.passage: Then he realized what he had done wrong. He ①<u>had</u> been too hasty and too greedy. He had not ②<u>gave</u> enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when ③<u>compared</u> to other bicycles, his price was too high. He added more photos to ④<u>show</u> his bike from different angles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 'had + 과거분사(과거완료)'이므로 had not given으로 써야 한다. gave(과거형)는 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ② gave 가 틀림 — 'had not + 과거분사'(과거완료)여야 하므로 had not given으로 써야 한다. 과거형 gave는 올 수 없다.
❌ ① had : 'had been(그동안 ~했었다)'의 과거완료, 맞음.
❌ ③ compared : 'when (he was) compared to(~와 비교되었을 때)'의 분사구문(수동), 맞음.
❌ ④ show : 'to show(보여 주기 위해)'의 to부정사, 맞음.
det.tip: had + 과거분사 = 과거완료. give-gave-given.

questions.passage: This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a ①<u>lower</u> price. It was hard to ②<u>accept</u> at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, ③<u>handed</u> over his bike, and got the money he needed. He was ④<u>glad</u> to see his old bike go, but he was happy with himself.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 오래된 자전거가 떠나는 것을 보며 '슬펐다(sad)'. glad(기쁜)는 뒤의 but(그러나)과 어울리지 않아 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ glad(기쁜)가 부적절 — 오래된 자전거를 떠나보내서 '슬펐다(sad)'고 해야 뒤의 'but he was happy(그러나 만족했다)'와 자연스럽게 대조된다.
❌ ① lower(더 낮은) : 더 낮은 가격을 요구했다로 적절.
❌ ② accept(받아들이다) : 받아들이기 힘들었다로 적절.
❌ ③ handed(건넸다) : 자전거를 건네주었다로 적절.
det.tip: sad to see ~ go = ~이 떠나는 것을 보며 슬픈.

questions.passage: He was ①<u>bored</u>, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the ②<u>shiny</u> new bike. He could not wait to get a ③<u>reply</u> to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he ④<u>checked</u> the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 새 자전거를 상상하며 '신이 났다(excited)'. bored(지루한)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① bored(지루한)가 부적절 — 사려는 새 자전거를 상상하며 '신이 났다(excited)'고 해야 뒤의 기대감과 자연스럽다.
❌ ② shiny(반짝이는) : 반짝이는 새 자전거로 적절.
❌ ③ reply(답장) : 광고에 대한 답장으로 적절.
❌ ④ checked(확인했다) : 조회 수를 확인했다로 적절.
det.tip: excited = 신이 난 ↔ bored = 지루한.

questions.passage: Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.
"세윤이는 매일 자전거를 타고 학교에 간다."

det.korean: 본문: 'Seyun rides his bike to school every day.' 세윤이는 매일 자전거로 등교한다. 진술은 참(T).
det.analysis: 본문 첫 문장 'Seyun rides his bike to school every day'와 진술이 일치한다. → T.
det.tip: ride one's bike to school = 자전거를 타고 등교하다.

questions.passage: He acted fast. He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone and posted the picture, with a short comment, on an online market: "Used bike in excellent condition. Only 100,000 won. Please text me." He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.
"세윤이는 첫 게시물에 자전거 사진 여러 장과 긴 설명을 올렸다."

det.korean: 본문: 세윤이는 처음에 사진 '한 장(a photo)'과 '짧은 설명(a short comment)'만 올렸다. 따라서 진술은 거짓(F).
det.analysis: 본문 'He took a photo ~ and posted the picture, with a short comment'에 따르면 첫 게시물은 사진 한 장과 짧은 설명이었다. 진술의 '여러 장과 긴 설명'은 반대 → F.
det.tip: a photo = 사진 한 장, a short comment = 짧은 설명.

questions.passage: This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a lower price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.
"세윤이는 마침내 자전거를 70,000원에 팔았다."

det.korean: 본문: 'finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won.' 세윤이는 결국 70,000원에 팔았다. 진술은 참(T).
det.analysis: 본문 'but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won'과 진술이 일치한다. → T.
det.tip: sell ... for ~ = …을 (얼마)에 팔다.

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had __________ wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 자신이 무엇을 잘못 '했는지(done)' 깨달았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② done(했다) : 'what he had done wrong(자신이 무엇을 잘못 했는지)' 흐름에 맞으며, 뒤에 성급함·욕심 등 잘못이 이어진다.
❌ ① found(찾았다) : 뒤 내용(자신의 실수)과 어울리지 않음.
❌ ③ bought(샀다) : 문맥 무관.
❌ ④ sold(팔았다) : 아직 팔기 전 상황이라 어색.
det.tip: what he had done wrong = 그가 무엇을 잘못했는지.

questions.passage: As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post down the list. His heart began to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아무도 자전거를 원하지 않고 글이 밀려나자, 세윤이의 마음은 '가라앉기(sink)' 시작했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ sink(가라앉다) : 답장이 없고 글이 밀려 내려가 실망하는 흐름이므로 'heart began to sink(마음이 가라앉기 시작했다)'가 맞음.
❌ ① rise(오르다) : 긍정 상황이 아니라 반대.
❌ ② jump(뛰다) : 기쁨의 표현이라 문맥과 반대.
❌ ③ fly(날다) : 문맥 무관.
det.tip: one's heart sinks = 마음이 가라앉다(실망하다).

questions.passage: Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이의 자전거는 그에게 너무 '작아졌다(too small)'. 따라서 '커졌다'는 ③이 일치하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 불일치 — 본문 'His bike has become too small for him'은 자전거가 '작아졌다'는 뜻이라 '너무 커졌다'는 반대.
❌ ① 일치 — 'Seyun rides his bike to school every day'.
❌ ② 일치 — 'he is taller and stronger this year'.
❌ ④ 일치 — 'he does not have enough money in his savings account'.
det.tip: has become too small = 너무 작아졌다.

ch: 세윤이는 올해 키가 더 크고 힘도 세졌다.
세윤이는 예금 계좌에 돈이 충분하지 않다.

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. He added more photos to show his bike from different angles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 다른 자전거와 비교해 세윤이의 가격은 너무 '높았다(too high)'. 따라서 '더 낮게 매겼다'는 ②가 일치하지 않는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 불일치 — 본문 'his price was too high'는 가격이 '높았다'는 뜻이라 '더 낮게 매겼다'는 반대.
❌ ① 일치 — 'He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online'.
❌ ③ 일치 — 'He had been too hasty and too greedy'.
❌ ④ 일치 — 'He added more photos to show his bike from different angles'.
det.tip: price was too high = 가격이 너무 높았다.

ch: 세윤이는 인터넷에서 온라인 판매 요령을 검색했다.
세윤이는 다른 자전거보다 가격을 더 낮게 매겼었다.
세윤이는 자신이 너무 성급하고 욕심이 많았다고 느꼈다.
세윤이는 자전거를 여러 각도에서 보여 주려고 사진을 더 추가했다.

questions.passage: It was hard ① to accept at first, but finally he ② sold his bike for 70,000 won. He ③ meet the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed. He was happy with himself because he ④ had learned a lot.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 뒤의 handed, got처럼 과거시제로 이어지므로 '만났다'는 met으로 써야 한다. meet(현재형)은 틀림.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ meet 가 틀림 — 뒤의 handed, got과 같은 과거의 일이므로 과거형 met으로 써야 한다. meet-met-met.
❌ ① to accept : 'hard to accept(받아들이기 힘든)'의 to부정사, 맞음.
❌ ② sold : 'sell(팔다)'의 과거형, 맞음.
❌ ④ had learned : 'had + 과거분사'의 과거완료, 맞음.
det.tip: meet-met-met. 과거시제 서술에서는 met.

questions.passage: He could not wait to get a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts.
questions.stem:
다음 질문에 대한 답이 되는 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로)
Q: What did Seyun check every few minutes after posting his bike?
→ He checked the number of __________.

det.korean: 본문 'Every few minutes he checked the number of hits'에서 세윤이가 확인한 것은 '조회 수(hits)'이다.
det.analysis: 질문은 '세윤이가 몇 분마다 무엇을 확인했는가'이다. 본문 'he checked the number of hits'에서 답이 되는 단어는 hits(조회 수)이다.
det.tip: the number of hits = 조회 수.

questions.passage: Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high.
questions.stem:
다음 질문에 대한 답이 되는 영어 표현(2단어, 형용사+명사)을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로)
Q: Who did Seyun fail to give enough information to?
→ the __________ __________

det.korean: 본문 'He had not given enough information to the possible buyers'에서 정보를 충분히 주지 못한 대상은 '잠재적 구매자(possible buyers)'이다.
det.analysis: 질문은 '세윤이가 누구에게 충분한 정보를 주지 못했는가'이다. 본문 'to the possible buyers'에서 형용사 possible + 명사 buyers의 두 단어 possible buyers가 답이다.
det.tip: possible buyers = 잠재적 구매자.

questions.passage: He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself __________ (ride) the shiny new bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: see + 목적어 + 동사ing = (목적어가) ~하고 있는 것을 보다. '자신이 타고 있는 모습을 보다'이므로 riding이다.
det.analysis: 지각동사 see는 'see + 목적어 + 동사원형/동사ing' 형태로 씁니다. 진행 중인 모습을 강조할 때는 -ing를 쓰므로 ride → riding입니다. (see himself riding)
det.tip: see + 목적어 + V-ing = (목적어가) ~하고 있는 것을 보다.

questions.passage: This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a lower price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. Now he could get a new bike. He felt both happy and sad. He was sad to see his old bike go, but he was happy with himself because he had learned a lot and grown up a bit through the experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 온라인 판매를 직접 해 보며 실수도 겪었지만 많은 것을 배우고 조금 성장했다는 것이 요지이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ : 'he had learned a lot and grown up a bit through the experience'처럼 판매 경험을 통해 배우고 성장했다는 요지와 일치.
❌ ① 중고 거래는 손해 : 본문에 없는 과장.
❌ ② 새것만 사야 함 : 본문과 무관.
❌ ④ 비쌀수록 빨리 팔림 : 오히려 비싸서 안 팔렸다.
det.tip: learn a lot and grow up through the experience = 경험을 통해 배우고 성장하다.

ch: 중고 거래는 항상 손해를 보는 일이다.
세윤이는 온라인 판매 경험을 통해 배우고 성장했다.

questions.passage: Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글은 세윤이가 온라인으로 자전거를 처음 판매하게 되는 이야기이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 세윤이의 첫 온라인 판매 경험 : 자전거가 작아져 팔려고 하는 도입부로, 글 전체 제목 'Seyun's First Online Sale'과 일치.
❌ ② 자전거를 안전하게 타는 법 : 안전 수칙 글이 아님.
❌ ③ 좋은 스마트폰 고르는 법 : 본문과 무관.
❌ ④ 예금 계좌를 만드는 방법 : 소재일 뿐 주제가 아님.
det.tip: Seyun's First Online Sale = 세윤이의 첫 온라인 판매(제목).

questions.passage: However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "__________. Maybe I can sell it and add the money to buy a new one."
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 활용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 쓰시오. (영어로)
내 오래된 자전거는 거의 새것만큼 좋다.
[조건] (1) a, almost, as, as, bike, good, is, my, new, old, one을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~만큼 …한'은 'as + 형용사 + as' 원급 비교이다. '거의 새것만큼 좋다'는 almost as good as a new one.
det.analysis: 뼈대는 'My old bike is(내 오래된 자전거는) + almost as good as(거의 ~만큼 좋은) + a new one(새것)'입니다. 원급 비교는 'as + good + as'로 쓰고, a new one은 'a new bike'를 대신하는 표현입니다.
det.tip: as + 형용사 + as = ~만큼 …한 (원급 비교).

questions.wa: my old bike is almost as good as a new one
accept: my old bike is almost as good as a new one
